description:
FILED by the s532 Fable merge review (2026-11-02), probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s532/review/merge-review/probes/p-pipe-1.pl.  REGRESSION: base d47caabe = perl, main b31345ca differs.  Introduced by s529a (#3868 `local *NAME` gives the scope a fresh glob; MAIN-READY-53 44d39de3).

    { local(*NIL); open NIL, qq{|$^X -e "exit 23"} or die; $? = 42; }   # NIL implicitly closed here
    print "implicit: $?\n";       # perl 42   base 42   main 5888 (= 23 << 8)

The explicit `close NIL2` ($? >> 8 = 7), a plain file handle, and a glob VALUE returned out of the scope (`sub mk { local *P; open P, "|..."; return *P }` -- the handle kept, $? untouched) all match perl.

MECHANISM (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp): %p-glob-restore -> %p-local-glob-leave: for a scope that emptied the whole glob and OPENED a handle nobody kept, it calls (%p-close-impl io-sym), whose pipe arm (%p-close-maybe-pipe) waits for the child AND (box-set $? status) -- the EXPLICIT close's contract.  perl's scope-exit close is io_close(..., not_implicit = FALSE): it waits (the child IS reaped: io/pipe.t "child reaped if piped program cannot be executed" turned FIXED in the same run) but never sets $? (`if (not_implicit) STATUS_NATIVE_CHILD_SET(...)`).

FIX SHAPE: the implicit close in %p-local-glob-leave saves and restores $? around %p-close-impl (or calls a close variant that reaps without the status store -- ONE close path with an `implicit` flag, rule 11; the same flag belongs to any other implicit close PCL performs, e.g. the last reference to a lexical pipe handle when #2370's family lands).  Guard: a row in Pl/t/local-glob-01.t (the p-pipe-1 shape, inverse-checked on 44d39de3); then io/pipe.t's NEW row leaves baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv by a one-file run (tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 io/pipe.t).  ir-spec "local *name": add "the scope-exit close is implicit: it reaps, it does not write $?".

COMPANION ATTRIBUTION (for s531d): io/pipe.t NEW "status unaffected by implicit close" + FIXED "child reaped if piped program cannot be executed" are both this commit.
subject: REGRESSION (s529a #3868, silent wrong): the IMPLICIT close of a pipe at the end of a `local *FH` scope stores the child status into $? -- perl leaves $? untouched (io_close not_implicit=FALSE); t/io/pipe.t "status unaffected by implicit close" is the NEW companion row
